mood.summary: Equities are rebounding strongly after digesting the Fed's 25 bps rate hike and hawkish forward guidance, aided by retreating Treasury yields and softer crude oil prices. Focus on high-RS leaders with confirmed volume while avoiding extended chasing.

indicesNarrative: US equities are breaking a three-day losing streak as market participants digest yesterday's 25 bps rate hike by the Federal Reserve and interpret the hawkish stance as largely priced in. Tech and large-cap growth (QQQ) are spearheading the advance with solid breath participation, while the drop in 10-year Treasury yields under 5.0% and a near 10% decline in the VIX provide macro relief.
technicalsNarrative: Major indices sit in healthy FAIR to AT-MA territory following the shallow test of the 21-day EMA during yesterday's FOMC session. RSI across SPY and QQQ remains in the constructive 55-65 zone without overbought exhaustion, and MACD histograms are turning upward, making pullbacks to moving averages the safest entry profile.

traderLens.name: Minervini
traderLens.view: Market structure remains healthy in confirmed Stage 2 for tech leadership. Look for tight VCP structures near new highs rather than chasing morning gap extensions.

traderLens.name: Ted Zhang
traderLens.view: Clear capital rotation out of defensive energy/staples and straight back into AI semiconductors and industrial tech. Follow institutional volume flow.

traderLens.name: Clement Ang
traderLens.view: Macro hurdle (FOMC rate decision) is out of the way. Market context is supportive for selective A-grade swing entries, but enforce strict stop levels.

traderLens.name: SRxTrades
traderLens.view: Focus on clean intraday volume confirmation at pivotal price levels. Don't chase premarket gaps; wait for the first 15-30 minute range to establish.

traderLens.name: Jeff
traderLens.view: Keep mechanical execution tight. Size risk strictly to the 1% book rule and never move protective stops lower.

traderLens.name: Qullamaggie
traderLens.view: Prime environment for opening range high (ORH) momentum setups in semiconductor and tech names. Low-of-day stops ensure asymmetric risk/reward.

traderLens.name: Composite
traderLens.view: Deploy capital selectively into high-RS A-grade setups emerging from tight bases (NVDA, PLTR, META). Let opening volatility settle before executing ORH triggers.

standout.thesis: Reclaiming the 21-day EMA with expanding volume as macro interest rate overhang clears. Strongest relative strength in megacap tech with clean overhead room to swing highs.

alert: Post-FOMC relief rally underway as 10-year yields slide below 5.0% and VIX drops under 16. Prioritize A-grade setups on tight base breakouts.
